answer: The reward itself is a measuring stick, not money: POA coins carry no market value — they only meter contribution to a research ledger. A sybil farm that scales a hundred puppets up the trellis of fake standing harvests numbers that buy nothing, while burning real compute and real judgment every epoch. The honest miner's glacier-paced accrual costs a puppet-operator more in electricity and attention than any ledger score is worth. Fraud here is felling timber to build a stage set: full expense, no structure. Attacker cost: everything; attacker gain: a number.
